steps.text: Some people say mercenaries are like MREs. Meals, ready-to-eat.
Can be eaten right out of the bag. Disposable. High efficiency, low risk. The best kind of field ration.
But if given a choice, practically everyone would choose to eat fresh, hot food. And practically no one would choose to risk their lives just to earn their next meal.
If given a choice.
All units take note, the target has entered the alert range, and is expected to reach the defense point in one minute.
All units are to complete emergency preparations within thirty seconds. Repeat, all units are to complete emergency preparations within thirty seconds.
Over.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Um, I'm here to see if you need any help?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, there you are, Cutter.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You're just in time to try my veggie flatbread, fresh from the oven!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Thanks, I think I will.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Mm... It's really good.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haha, I don't call it my specialty for nothing.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Why not take a few more for the road? Don't be shy now.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Uhh, I appreciate it, but I'm good. I'm just here to see if there's anything I can help you with.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ehh? I'm pretty much done cooking on my end. Maybe you can go check on Matterhorn though!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Oh, Cutter! Perfect timing. Here, try my Kjerag-style braised meat.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I substituted scalesaur meat because it's easier to get, and changed the seasonings accordingly. But I was just thinking I needed a taste-tester.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Mm, sure. I'll try some.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: (Chews)

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Very good. I can't say much else about it... but it's very tasty.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Nothing to write home about then? Hmm... Looks like I'll have to work on the flavor to make it more distinctive.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: No, that's not what I meant. I'm just not very good at... describing things. Believe me, Matterhorn, your cooking is top notch!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: By the way, could you use any help?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Haha, I'm all squared away over here. All the dishes are already cooking, so all that's left is to turn off the heat later. Gummy might need help though, in a bit.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Actually, wait. There is something. I experimented with a few more new dishes today, and I'd like your opinion on all of them, if it's not too much trouble.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Cutter! Come try some of Gummy's fried pies!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I'm kind of full...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: But do you need help with anything, Gummy?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I've already finished frying up my pies~

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Then, I suppose I can try one.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Is it good?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I... think so?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Urgh... Can't take another bite...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I just wanted to lend a hand, but ended up getting treated to an early lunch and then some.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Well, at least everyone's been real good to me.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm here to help!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, Sideroca, right on time. Two of our logistics operators took the day off, so the three of us are a bit short-staffed right now.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: We might be able to manage if we all went full throttle, but I'd rather not burn ourselves out for no reason.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: My arm's all sore...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Well, your savior has arrived! Good work hanging on so long.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, and I happened to see Cutter in the cafeteria just now. Had a real mopey look on her face. Any idea what's wrong with her?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right, you don't come by the kitchen a lot, so you might not know...
One month ago...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Good work everyone. Um... but is there anything I can help with?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ohh, you must be Cutter, the new arrival. Perfect timing—could you chop up those potatoes into chunks, if you don't mind? We'll be making soup soon.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Mm, got it.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Cutter! I asked you to chop the potatoes, not the cutting board!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It was an accident! I'll pay for it—

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: No, it's fine, don't worry about it. I guess you're not very experienced with a kitchen knife? Just keep an eye on the pot then. Remember to stir it around with a ladle every now and then, so it doesn't burn.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Understood. I won't mess up this time!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Stir, stir... Don't let it burn, stir...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Stir, stir...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: (Sniffs) What's that smell?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: As much as it pains me to do this to her, as one of Rhodes Island's kitchen staff, I absolutely can't have a repeat of last time.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The lady in the logistics department even thought about adding a 'Cutter is not allowed in here' sign next to the 'Kay is not allowed' one...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I'd rather avoid unnecessary food waste, if possible.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, I see...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: But I won't stand for it!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Cutter! Get back here!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Huh? Sideroca?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You're not allowed to throw in the towel, ever!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It's for the best. I just mess things up for everyone else anyway.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Don't worry about that. We've got plenty of time until dinner, so who cares if you make a few mistakes on the way?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Are you sure? I really appreciate it.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Don't mention it. I just think that if you want to do something, you should see it through to the end.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: So starting from today, I'm going to give you a crash course in cooking!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Relax. With me here, there won't be a repeat of last time.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I'll do my best, Sideroca!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Thank you very much!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I'm your instructor now, so let me hear a 'yes, ma'am!'

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: (Haha, so this is what it feels like to be an instructor.)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Ahem... Pop quiz! What do you think cooking is?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Making food fit to eat?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Wrong! You couldn't be more wrong!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It's not as simple as making something edible. Remember this: cooking is the art of bringing out the characteristics of each ingredient to make something delicious!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I, I'll keep that in mind!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: From the looks of it, you don't even know the fundamentals. In which case, I'll have to start from the basics. Stand at attention and follow my orders!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The first, most basic thing you need for any dish is knife work.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Listen up! First, raise your knife!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Um, with my left or right hand...?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Well, with your dominant hand. Then hold the potato with your other hand, and run the knife along the contours and gently peel off its skin, like this...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Follow the contours... Gently... Oh, it flew across the room.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How in the—

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How can someone named 'Cutter' be this bad with a blade?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Cutting vegetables feels completely different from cutting my enemies.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I mean, I get you, but... the ingredients are not your enemies.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: In any case, practice makes perfect, same as any skill. So let's keep practicing!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: You're amazing, ma'am. I never knew mashed potatoes could taste so good.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Haha, we can't let perfectly good food go to waste, after all...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: (After seeing so many potatoes gutted like that, I couldn't think of any other way to use them.)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: See, cooking isn't so difficult. Once you've gotten the feel of handling a kitchen knife, you'll be peeling potatoes, no problem.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: But then I almost burned a hole through the pot while waiting for it to heat up...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You're still too tense, Cutter. Cooking isn't like swordsmanship. You can't expect to get it down just by mechanically imitating a teacher, like finishing an assignment.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It's about understanding your ingredients, and turning them into what you hope for.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Right! The most important thing is hope!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: That makes perfect sense! Mm, I'll remember that.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: By the way, why do you want to cook so much?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You should already be able to find any kind of cuisine you like in the Rhodes Island cafeteria, right?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It's because... I've never had anything but MREs. So I want to know what it's like to eat something I made with my own hands.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Well, maybe not 'never,' but I was following my master for as long as I can remember, and my master didn't know how to cook either.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Later on, after I became a mercenary, I had even fewer opportunities to sit down and enjoy a peaceful meal.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I was really curious about how food was made, so one time I slipped into a tavern's kitchen to go take a look. The owner thought I was a thief though, and ended up scolding me all night. Ahaha...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Cutter!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Hwah! Yes, ma'am?!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I swear, I'll teach you how to cook if it's the last thing I do!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Even if we have to sacrifice a dozen potatoes, no, a hundred, I swear I'll teach you!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Um, please calm down. That's all in the past now. And look, I survived and stayed healthy—

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Finish up your mashed potatoes, and we'll continue the training!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I can't believe I ended up using the rest of the potatoes and she had to go look for more ingredients...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Getting kind of... sleepy...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: No, no, I can't let her down now!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I just learned how to peel potatoes, so I can't afford to slack off already!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: *Yawn*... But the afternoon sun is so comfy...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I can't keep my eyes open...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Maybe a little nap...
Hey, wake up.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Here, this is yours.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Lucky you, you can fall asleep even at a time like this. But that's fine. There's still time before we head out, so conserve your strength while you can.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Hey, you over there. Catch.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Again with the canned food?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: We're lucky we even have canned food. You got any idea what happens to mercs who lose their supplies out in the barrens?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: You collapse on the ground out here, and scavenging Originium slugs think you're a carcass and start gnawing on your clothes from your legs up. You're still conscious by the time they get to your flesh.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Speaking of which, I'm sure in the mood for some coal-grilled sandworm legs. Preferably fresh.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: *Columbian profanity* You wish.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Why can't we grill something anyway? I'd even settle for soup at this point.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: We're in the barrens, and there's no wind. Fire means smoke, which means anybody can spot us from miles away.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Might as well be broadcasting 'there's a caravan here' to all the other mercenaries in the area.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: We're escorting goods this time, so we can't afford to blow our position.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Ooh, the little girl's talking like a pro now. How many runs have you made at your age?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Too many to count.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Done pretty much everything except fraud and trafficking. I've probably been doing this longer than you, too.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: You talk a big game. But how do you know when I got in the biz?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Your knife.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It's one of the latest from Raythean, put out just last year. Brand new materials, and half the weight of the previous generation. No signs of wear and tear on your belt sheath either, so you can't have used other knives before.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Impressive. You sure know your stuff.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I'm only doing this because I lost my farm in a Catastrophe. Who the heck would take a job that puts a bounty on their head if they had any land to grow crops on?

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Heh. Still, I might be the newbie here, but I've never screwed up a job.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: If we bump into any bandits, I'll show you what I'm capable of.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Bah. Don't jinx us.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Can't you take a joke? We did a great job covering up our trail, and we only got our route just before setting off.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: That's the best way to keep it secret.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Some employers prepare multiple route maps in advance and keep them sealed. Before departure, a middleman will randomly select one and hand it to the mercenaries.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Then we're allowed to refuse the job if the seal has been tampered with.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: This avoids direct contact between the mercenaries and the employers, and also eliminates the risk of leaks. Our client kept things professional this time.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: What a stand-up guy. Makes you wonder what the hell is in these boxes to be worth all this trouble.

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: We just drop off the goods at the destination, grab our money, and leave. Nothing else matters.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: True. But when they're paying this much just to move 'em, they must be worth a pretty penny! Makes me feel like I'm in the big leagues now, hahaha!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Soon as I get my hands on that cash, I'm gonna find a good bar and drink myself silly.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: A few more contracts like this, maybe I'll even head south, buy another plot of land, and open another brewery! Hahaha!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: What about you guys? What are you gonna do with the money?

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Can't say I share your optimism, so I'll need to find a weaponsmith for crossbow maintenance first.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: How about you, girlie?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: A new hairclip, probably.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Huh? What'd you say?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I lost my last one. My bangs sometimes fall down and block my vision, and it's a pain in the ass.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Ahahahahaha—

steps.name: Mercenary A
steps.text: Bwahahaha...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: What's so funny?

a.text: The value and purpose of the food is never for it to decide.
And after the usable portions have been squeezed out, what remains is just excess waste.
Waste, to be tossed away in the barrens without a second thought.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: We're the only ones still alive...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: That attack was clearly premeditated.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I can't say for sure what happened, but someone must have deliberately exposed our position—

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: What are you doing? Forget about the goods. We're already exposed, and there'll be more after us before long!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: We've already failed the mission! You need to head to the town up ahead and find a way to deal with your injuries—

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Do you not see this chunk of Originium in my neck?! It's over for me!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: I'm already dead! I just want to take a goddamn look at the shit I'm dying over!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: There's no need for you to—

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Hah... Haha... Hahahahahaha!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Empty. There's nothing inside!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: We've been nothing more than goddamn bait from the very beginning! That money... was the price of our heads!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: I'm such an idiot. How could I get caught up in other people's bullshit? As if being a mercenary can just endlessly shit out money.

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Hahaha... But I suppose they're right about one thing. Die fast enough, and you won't have any need for money!

steps.name: Mercenary B
steps.text: Damn it all! All you mercs can go to hell!
Hey, Cutter? Wake up.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Ah! Sorry, how long was I asleep?

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Your training's been getting rough recently.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Still, it's been a month, and it's time to check on your progress. So chin up and show me what you've got!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: You ready?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Mm... Mhm!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: (Swallows nervously)

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: (Carefully lifts the lid of the pot)

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I've finally... finished.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Woooah, this looks pretty promising!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I knew you could do it, Cutter!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It's all thanks to you, Sideroca. I'd never have managed it alone.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Who cares about that? Let me have a taste!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: W-Wait!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Maybe I should try it myself first...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: (Chews)

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How is it?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It seems...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Seems what?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Not very good.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Hm? Let me try.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: What are you talking about? It's great. You're too hard on yourself. I'd even believe it if you told me Matterhorn made it.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: You're exaggerating...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: No, I'm not. How do I put this? This is definitely your own style of cooking!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: I was dumbstruck when you said you'd make canned sandworm risotto at the end of our 'class,' but I never expected it to be this delicious!

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: The heavy seasoning from the canned worms was mellowed out by the rice, and the meat tasted much better after being re-cooked.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Damn, the mashed potatoes on the side cap things off perfectly too! I think this dish might even be worth a spot on the cafeteria menu!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I remembered what you said about 'understanding the ingredients, and turning them into what I hope for.' I kept thinking it over, and the only food I really understand is canned sandworms.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: That just proves you've mastered the art of cooking!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: But I only know how to make one dish.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Sure, for now, but it's an entirely new beginning for you!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Mm, I'll keep that in mind.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: It's much more than trying to finish an assignment. It's about having hope... and creating something I want.
